feed.title: NPR Topics: Home Page Top Stories
feed.subtitle: Top stories in the U.S. and world news, politics, health, science, business, music, arts and culture. Nonprofit journalism with a mission. This is NPR.

entry.title: A D.C. park was made 'for the pleasure of the people.' Trump's plan would change that
entry.summary: Trump's most recent rendering of East Potomac Park overtakes the D.C. peninsula with a sprawling golf course, without the grassy areas and road beloved by locals. That's prompted grassroots pushback.

entry.title: 'Possible Love' offers four of the best performances you'll see all year
entry.summary: Lee Chang-dong's novelistic drama tells the story of two very different couples who meet during the filming of a documentary.

entry.title: 'Clayface' is underbaked body horror
entry.summary: Like its protagonist, the film shoots out its goopy, mud-brown, protoplasmic feelers into the undiscovered territory of horror, but it does so too tentatively.

entry.title: Ex-FBI employees charged with lying to Congress over Hunter Biden inquiries
entry.summary: Republicans have long accused the FBI of mishandling the laptop and the investigations into the younger Biden.

entry.title: Will a macaque eat a grape sitting on a pile of poo? A study on germophobia
entry.summary: When an outbreak strikes, humans try to avoid germs. (Remember wiping off groceries at the start of the pandemic?) What about ... monkeys?

entry.title: Authorities investigating whether first Kenya and Nigeria Ebola cases crossed paths
entry.summary: Nigeria this week recorded its first case of Ebola in the current outbreak, which has spread from the epicenter in Congo to several other African countries.

entry.title: Israel orders closure of West Bank after soldiers kill 2 men behind an alleged attack
entry.summary: Israeli soldiers shot and killed two men who the military said had launched an attack near the city of Hebron in the occupied West Bank on Friday morning. At least five people were injured, including some critically.

entry.title: Hacking attempts rise after flaws found in program affecting 70% of websites
entry.summary: Governments around the world are rushing to implement safety measures after AI technology found "severe" vulnerabilities in a key programming language called PHP.

entry.title: Why going on a 'say no' retreat is a gift to your future self
entry.summary: It's a day to think about all the upcoming appointments and commitments you're dreading — and then decline some of them. Writer Caroline Sylge shares a suggested schedule for the day.

entry.title: Amid Trump's assaults on DEI, how one university is elevating Black students
entry.summary: As many colleges roll back or eliminate such programs, Sacramento State has expanded its offerings for students of color.
